archive.name: feeding_strategies_zenodo.zip
archive.acquisition_method: HTTP Range partial retrieval; parse ZIP central directory, inflate selected culture-data members, verify each against directory CRC32.
limitations: Only the six listed culture-data members were acquired; raw mass spectra and full protocol workbook were not acquired.
Full archive MD5 is publisher-reported and not independently verified; individual SHA-256 and ZIP CRC32 checks cover extracted members only.
No biological recomputation, experimental replication, or calibration validation is established by integrity checks.

condition_mapping_source: Authors merged data/03_ViCell_titer.csv: CR_TP leading letter maps raw condition to named Condition; intervention parameters from paper Table 1 and Methods, Fed-batch feeding strategies.

protocol_context.main_feed: 66.0% EX-CELL Advanced CHO Feed 1 + 33.0% Cellvento 4Feed COMP as reported
protocol_context.glucose_semantics: Replenish measured glucose to target concentration; values are not fixed bolus additions.
protocol_context.volume_normalization: Authors normalized total addition volume using nuclease-free water.
protocol_context.full_protocol_status: Paper methods summarized here; detailed Zenodo protocol workbook not included in six-member extraction.

grouping_and_interpretation.experimental_unit: One condition-specific biological replicate within campaign batch. Replicate number alone is not a unique culture ID.
grouping_and_interpretation.replicate_normalization: Raw growth/lactate use R1 etc; titer/merged/glucose use 1 etc. Strip R only after preserving original fields.
grouping_and_interpretation.campaign_confounding: FB4 contains STD, STD+, LoG, LoG+; FB2 contains HiF, HIP, HIP+. The low-glucose versus high-frequency contrast crosses campaigns and also changes main-feed amount per event. Do not describe it as randomized same-campaign isolation of feeding frequency.
holdout_rules: Keep all timepoints and all assay tables of a culture together; no row-random split.
Keep averaged growth table out of independent evidence counts: it summarizes the same cultures.
Merged growth/titer table duplicates source data; do not count as extra replicates.
Campaign holdout holds out treatment families, because campaigns and strategies are confounded. Report this limitation rather than claiming receiver generalization.
A fixed-condition replicate holdout tests interpolation under the same published treatment; it does not identify unobserved intervention outcomes.
grouping_and_interpretation.outcome_claim: Actual prospective assigned feeding strategies with measured culture performance; low-glucose depletion/collapse and alternative preventive schedules. Not same-vessel rescue, not oxygen-transfer correction, and not penicillin-model validation.
